messages.subject_clean: how to differentiate two group with different color in scatter plot
messages.body_plain:
Hello MaAsLin Group,
                           I am studying two groups (Normal and Obese). After MaAsLin, in scatter, plots, these two groups (mean all samples) are in the same colors (black dots) and I am not able to differentiate.  Please someone can suggest if is there any command or script to indicate this two group into a different color?

Thanks,
Sincerely,
Khemlal Nirmalkar
PhD Student,
CINVESTAV-IPN

messages.body_plain:
Hello,

When I run an analysis with two genotypes (called WT for wildtype and KO for knockout). My output has created a third category, also called WT, with only 1 sample in it. So there is KO, WT, and WT. I have checked to make sure the input file only has 2 genotype categories in it. Why is this third category coming up? I have attached the output files.

Thanks!
